meta.title: OpenChat Atlas
meta.description: A free-first index of official AI chatbot destinations

entries.name: ChatGPT Free
entries.desc: Ask, write, learn, plan, and explore with OpenAI's everyday conversational assistant.

entries.name: GPTs
entries.desc: Browse purpose-built assistants for writing, research, coding, learning, and more.

entries.name: Free plan
entries.desc: See the current no-cost plan details, included tools, and usage notes before you start.

entries.name: Desktop apps
entries.desc: Take ChatGPT to your computer with official desktop downloads for supported platforms.

entries.name: ChatGPT home
entries.desc: A clean route into the ChatGPT product surface when you want the simplest possible start.

entries.desc: Experiment with OpenAI models and prompts in the developer workspace. Billing may apply.

entries.name: Claude
entries.desc: A focused AI assistant from Anthropic for writing, analysis, and careful problem solving.

entries.name: Gemini
entries.desc: Google's AI assistant for writing, planning, brainstorming, and everyday questions.

entries.name: Copilot
entries.desc: Microsoft's conversational companion for answers, ideas, and getting more done.

entries.name: Perplexity
entries.desc: Research the open web in real time and get concise answers with cited sources.

entries.name: Grok
entries.desc: An AI assistant from SpaceXAI for chat, creation, coding, and real-time web answers.

entries.name: Meta AI
entries.desc: Meta's assistant for questions, image creation, and everyday tasks across its ecosystem.

entries.name: Poe
entries.desc: Explore a large collection of chatbots and compare different AI voices in one place.

entries.name: DeepSeek
entries.desc: Chat with DeepSeek's general-purpose assistant for reasoning, research, and code.

entries.name: Anima
entries.desc: An AI friend for open-ended chat, roleplay, and practicing communication in the browser.

entries.name: Blackbox AI
entries.desc: A coding-focused assistant for generating, explaining, and transforming software in the browser.

entries.name: Character.AI
entries.desc: Talk with community-created characters and build imaginative conversational experiences.

entries.name: Chatsonic
entries.desc: A free-plan AI chat workspace for research, writing, and marketing-focused creation.

entries.name: DeepAI Chat
entries.desc: A lightweight web chat for asking questions and exploring generative AI tools.

entries.name: HuggingChat
entries.desc: Chat with open-source models and explore a community-powered AI workspace.

entries.name: Jina Reader
entries.desc: Turn web pages into clean, AI-ready reading material with a free, rate-limited reader service.

entries.name: Kimi
entries.desc: A general assistant for research, writing, and working through long prompts and documents.

entries.name: Le Chat
entries.desc: Mistral's conversational assistant for writing, analysis, coding, and creative work.

entries.name: NotebookLM

entries.name: OpenRouter Chat
entries.desc: Compare responses from many AI models in one chat surface, with free models available to try.

entries.name: Phind
entries.desc: A developer-oriented answer engine for debugging, research, and technical problem solving.

entries.name: Pi
entries.desc: A conversational AI companion designed for thoughtful everyday dialogue and reflection.

entries.name: Qwen Chat
entries.desc: Qwen's official chat workspace for general questions, reasoning, and creative tasks.

entries.name: Replika
entries.desc: An AI companion for chatting, reflecting, and building a continuing conversational relationship.

entries.name: Talkie
entries.desc: Chat with AI characters for free and discover personalized conversational companions.

entries.name: Venice
entries.desc: A privacy-forward AI workspace for text, images, characters, and creative experimentation.

entries.name: Wysa
entries.desc: An anonymous AI wellbeing guide for talking through everyday thoughts and practicing supportive exercises.

entries.name: X / Grok
entries.desc: Open the Grok experience from xAI's official product page and explore its real-time assistant features.

entries.name: You.com
entries.desc: Search, ask, and work with AI-powered answers across a broad web research workspace.

entries.name: Z.ai
entries.desc: A conversational entry point into Z.ai's GLM family and open model ecosystem.
